provenance.notes: A generated character, not a real person. No real-person inputs: text prompt only, no image input, no LoRA. Head built with LAM (aigc3d/LAM, Apache-2.0 code, lam-20k weights CC BY-NC 4.0) on FLAME 2023 Open (CC BY 4.0, Li et al. 2017), argus-mask's FLAME core and landmark embedding, MediaPipe Face Mesh landmarks (Apache-2.0), BiRefNet-portrait matte (MIT) and VGGHeads crop (MIT code, CC BY-NC 4.0 weights). Rest set fitted to the portrait (lam/fit_rest.py, #151). Look-alike check: 2026-11-22, a reverse image search of source/portrait.png and a look, by the maintainer: no look-alikes.
